mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading highlights the 50° angle between MP and MS. Right image: The shading designates the annular area inside the outer circle and outside the inner circle.
Rationales: The feature highlights the angle between two rays in the left image and selects a geometric area in the right image. The red wedge at M between MP and MS. The light-blue ring between the circles marked R = 7 and r = 5.
